title: Voice-guided real-time AI improves endoscopic ultrasound completeness in a trial
summary: EUS-GUIDEQ recognizes scanning stations in real time and gives voice prompts and completeness feedback, trained on 27,072 annotated images from 189 patients. Station classification accuracy was 94.2% internally and 78.8% on 2062 external multicenter images. In a single-center randomized trial of 266 patients, median station completeness was 1.00 with AI versus 0.81 with standard EUS.
ai_technology: Real-time deep learning station recognition with voice guidance and quality control
organization: Central South University; Third Xiangya Hospital

evidence.tested: Internal and external image validation, then a single-center randomized trial with blinded video adjudication (132 vs 134 patients).
evidence.unknown: Single center; process-quality endpoint rather than patient outcomes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AI recognizes endoscopic ultrasound stations and gives live prompts.
